title: Extend filter-pixel-oracle to the remaining 5 filter types (Bevel/GradientGlow/GradientBevel/ColorMatrix/Convolution)
description:
DONE (agent-1242). Extended apps/desktop/e2e/filter-pixel-oracle.spec.ts from 3 to ALL 8 SWF filter types. Added a shared FILTERLIST decoder to apps/desktop/e2e/helpers/swf-parse.ts (decodePlaceObject3 / findSoleFilteredPlaceObject3) that walks the PlaceObject3 (tag 70) flag-gated fields and decodes each FILTERLIST entry.

OBSERVABLE PER FILTER (3 categories):
 A. REAL RUFFLE PIXEL ORACLE (filters Ruffle 0.2.0 renders):
   - Bevel(3): outside-bounds yellow-highlight/blue-shadow spill vs no-filter control (delta > 800).
   - ColorMatrix/AdjustColor(6): IN-BOUNDS mean-RGB shift (hue150+sat100+contrast60 recolours the red fill) vs control (delta > 60). No halo, so outside delta would be ~0 either way -> in-bounds is the right observable.
   (plus the 3 pre-existing: glow/drop-shadow/blur.)
 B. STRUCTURAL FILTERLIST DECODE (filters Ruffle 0.2.0 has NO wgpu renderer for -> they no-op to ZERO pixels, so a pixel oracle is impossible/false-failure):
   - GradientGlow(4): asserts HasFilterList set, FilterID 4 present, numColors=3, magenta+cyan stop RGBA survive.
   - GradientBevel(7): HasFilterList, FilterID 7, numColors=3, red+green stop RGBA survive, ON_TOP flag bit (0x10) set for bevelType:full (task 1142 field).
   - Convolution(5): HasFilterList, FilterID 5, matrixX/Y=3, edge-detect kernel centre=8 survives, AND the task-1236 flag bits: PRESERVE_ALPHA(bit0)=0 for preserveAlpha:false, CLAMP(bit1)=1 for clamp:true.

WHY STRUCTURAL FOR 4/5/7: bundled public/ruffle is 0.2.0; its render/wgpu/src/filters/ has ONLY bevel/blur/color_matrix/displacement_map/glow modules (verified via strings on the bundled .wasm; the render layer maps gradient-glow/gradient-bevel/convolution to 'Unsupported filter' and rasterises nothing). The encoder is correct (packages/swf/src/filters.ts) and the 1238/1236/1239 tag-level fixes are in main, so the filters reach Ruffle -- Ruffle just has no renderer for these 3. The structural decode still guards the EXACT regression classes the task targets (1238 filter-dropped, 1236 convolution flag-swap).

VERIFIED in real Ruffle + publish path:
  cd apps/desktop && npx playwright test e2e/filter-pixel-oracle.spec.ts  =>  8 passed (30-35s).

COUNTERFACTUAL PROOF (task-1238 drop emulation): temporarily forced filters:[] in makeFilteredRectDoc -> ALL 8 tests FAILED, incl. the 3 new structural ones (findSoleFilteredPlaceObject3 throws 'expected exactly 1 PlaceObject3 with a FILTERLIST, found 0'). Reverted -> 8 passed. This is the proof a byte-presence test can't give.

SCOPE: apps/desktop/e2e only (spec + helpers/swf-parse.ts). No product code. CI-skipped like the rest of the file. Unit suites: @flash/swf 1446/1446 pass; @flash/core 5295/5297 (only the pre-existing task-1207 flash8-empty.fla ENOENT fixture failures in carchive-validate/contents-structure/empty-bytematch, unrelated).
